_doc: 1:1 schema source of truth for the planner STEP 4 (C) TRANSITION objects (the transitions[] array). One object per inter-cut transition that needs its own single-canvas board.
type: cut | dissolve | match_action | match_cut | whip_pan | morph | push_in | pull_out | dolly_through | 360_spin
_image_crafter: A flashy (non-cut) transition gets its own board via lsb-image-crafter/prompts/transition_board.md (end of from_cut + apex + start of to_cut on one canvas). single_canvas=true ones are NOT sliced.
